thread:
olivia: opened a small docs PR to add a brief bootstrap checklist for KMS on air-gapped installs. two quick asks: (1) short apt/yum steps to install mirror CA, and (2) a one-line verify command. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234

kevin: please keep examples copy-paste. apt vs yum commands are different; include both. also show the minimal secret for imagePullSecrets.

olivia: draft snippets added:

olivia: ```bash
# Debian/Ubuntu
sudo cp mirror-ca.pem /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/mirror-ca.crt && sudo update-ca-certificates && sudo systemctl restart containerd
# RHEL/CentOS
sudo cp mirror-ca.pem /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/mirror-ca.crt && sudo update-ca-trust extract && sudo systemctl restart crio
# quick TLS check
openssl s_client -connect mirror.internal:443 -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt | head -n 20
```

sasha: add the imagePullSecrets minimal secret so installers can reference it in redwood-system.

sasha: ```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: mirror-pull-secret
  namespace: redwood-system
type: kubernetes.io/dockerconfigjson
stringData:
  .dockerconfigjson: |
    {"auths": {"mirror.internal:443": {"auth": "<base64>"}}}
```

kevin: also include `kubectl auth can-i` check for kms SA to avoid false permission tickets:

kevin: ```bash
kubectl auth can-i get secrets --namespace redwood-system --as=system:serviceaccount:redwood-system:kms-sa
```

docs-bot: reminder: run `make docs-lint`, update docs/TOC.md if you add a subsection, and add a one-line CHANGELOG.md entry under "docs". prefer docs/reference/* internal paths to avoid linkcheck failures.

marta-cs: this is great — i'll paste a one-line checklist into the onboarding runbook after backport. can someone backport to release/1.2.x once merged?

olivia: will backport and ping you. merging after CI passes. thanks all!
